en: You don't need to wait for me. (to a friend)
es: No hace falta que me esperes.
why: It is not needed, nothing is banned: no hace falta.

en: It is forbidden for you to park here. (to a friend)
why: Parking is not allowed, so está prohibido.

en: It is forbidden for customers to smoke inside.
es: Está prohibido que los clientes fumen adentro.
why: A rule against doing it is está prohibido.

en: You don't need to call me tonight. (to a friend)
es: No hace falta que me llames esta noche.
why: Calling is optional, so no hace falta.

en: You don't need to pay for the coffee. (formal)
es: No hace falta que pague el café.
why: Paying is not needed, not banned: no hace falta.

en: It is forbidden for anyone to go into the office.
es: Está prohibido que alguien pase a la oficina.
why: Entry is banned, so está prohibido.
